questions.question: Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, was alarmed that Gibeon had made peace with Israel. What did he do?

answers.text: Called four other kings to help him attack Gibeon
Sent gifts to Joshua to make peace
Moved all his people out of Jerusalem

questions.question: When Joshua went to fight the five Amorite kings at Gibeon, what did the LORD tell him?

answers.text: Not to be afraid because He had given them to Joshua
To send messengers and talk with the kings first
To take only the mighty men and leave the rest

questions.question: In Joshua's battle at Gibeon, Israel's swords killed more of the fleeing Amorites than the hailstones did. True or false?
During the battle against five Amorite kings at Gibeon, what did Joshua ask the LORD for in front of Israel?

answers.text: The sun and moon to stand still
The stars to fall on the enemy
Dark clouds to hide the whole army
